findings.claim: 10-K FY2025：關稅與出口管制（含商務部對中國客戶限制）已限制公司在部分市場的競爭力；近期關稅變動至今未造成重大不利影響，但未來新增關稅可能有重大影響。
findings.excerpt: We are subject to tariffs and restrictions from the dynamically changing global trade environment. While it is difficult to quantify the exact impact, current trade restrictions are limiting our ability to be competitive, particularly in certain markets, where some competitors are not subjected to the same restrictions.

findings.claim: 10-K：部分中國半導體公司被列入實體清單，對公司與這些客戶的業務已有且將持續有不利影響。
findings.excerpt: The addition of certain of these companies to the Entity List has had and will continue to have an adverse impact on our business with these customers.

findings.claim: 10-K：供應商受關稅與出口限制規範，可能影響零組件供應或提高價格。
findings.excerpt: Our suppliers are subject to trade regulations, including tariffs and export restrictions imposed by the United States Government and by the governments of other countries. These regulations could impact our suppliers’ ability to provide us with components for our products or could increase the price of those components.

findings.claim: 10-K MD&A：FY2025 貿易法規遵循成本不重大。
findings.excerpt: The costs we incurred in complying with applicable trade regulations for the year ended December 31, 2025 were not material, however, compliance with these laws has limited our ability to compete in certain regions.

findings.claim: Section 232 對半導體及半導體製造設備課徵關稅，2026-01-15 生效，25% 稅率（有特定用途豁免）。
